items.claim: The grouped-path join  reads the other path the wrong way: `commitJoin` takes it from the raw scene node, so the joined anchors land in the group's local frame
items.note: it now reads `editAnchors.getEditablePath`, the same path the press was aimed at. That also covers form-backed nodes, since anchors are now numbered from the same edit path.

items.claim: The double click on another path's end  joins, then leaves a stray one-anchor path
items.note: a join now sets `justClosed` the way a close does, so the double click takes the second anchor back.

items.claim: A drag from the first anchor  adds an anchor on top of it instead of closing
items.note: the drag now closes the path and pulls the first anchor's handles, mirrored. Canceling puts the handles back, and the close and click paths now share one `closeCurrent` helper.

items.claim: A continued path stores a lone one-anchor subpath : a single click after a close, then Enter, lands in the node
items.note: `commitPen` drops it, as the new-path branch already did.
